title: Meta Platforms, Inc. quarterly report for the period ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Quarterly Report Pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: Meta's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 60.801 billion quarterly revenue, USD 18.775 billion operating income, USD 15.848 billion net income, USD 90.26 billion cash and marketable securities, USD 83.664 billion long-term debt, and 2.548 billion Class A and Class B shares outstanding. It documents sharply higher AI infrastructure investment, stock compensation, legal exposure, and Reality Labs losses.
